depth.scope: bounded shared RGB/depth archive-metadata lookup for50000 GT frames; no raw-tree walk, image hash/decode pass, or mask audit

masks.scope: Only exact mask failures observed during preparation are inspected; no mask-tree inventory.

license.object_models: CC BY-SA with no sale/incorporation in products to be sold

meta.source_policy: official PBR only; no legacy HOT3D renders/checkpoints or HANDAL exclusion list; no repeated raw-tree audit

camera_protocol.validation_source: labelled train clips; no real train clips used for optimization
camera_protocol.coverage_gate: before training, require native annotation coverage for all33 objects; otherwise stop and explicitly revise/freeze the panel without model scores

rectification.principal_point: exact native c; never rounded to image center
rectification.FOV_loss_policy: native GT targets remain in validation denominator, including rectification misses

camera_protocol.primary_metrics: symmetry-aware MSSD in canonical mm and MSPD in original fisheye pixels normalized to640px; fixed top5 score-ranked predictions; misses retained; no VSD/AP claim
camera_protocol.static_supervision: released PNG masks/boxes with exact GT poses; no independently measured visibility claim; projected in-frame landmarks COCO1
camera_protocol.dynamic_supervision: RGB and sanitized intrinsics only; no masks or initial GT pose
camera_protocol.test_pose_frame: original designated camera, BOP rotation row-major and translations mm

meta.test_input_scope: only designated native-view RGB plus sanitized calibration; no test GT, object presence/count, masks, hands, or camera extrinsics used
